notes: Hand-rolled site, but the open-roles SPA fetches its entire inventory as one flat JSON array from /jobs/main.json (no auth, no cookies, plain GET, 200 via httpx).
Single full listing: 225 records at discovery, one per (position, city), distinct numeric ids (Greenhouse-style ...002 ids). No pagination anywhere.
The records carry no URL; detail pages verified at https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/position/{id}/ (200). Slug/suffix variants 404.

The visible list at /join-jane-street/open-roles/?type=... DEFAULTS TO A NEW YORK FILTER (94 rows). main.json is the superset across NYC/LDN/HKG/SGP — rendered NYC ids reconciled 94/94 against main.json city=NYC.
expected_min_jobs=100: total was 225 at discovery, and the largest single-city subset (NYC=94) sits below the floor, so a silent partial (one-city regression) trips the guard instead of passing.
Anti-scrape quirk: 3 records ('Machine Learning Researcher') spell M/L/R with Lisu homoglyphs (U+A4DF/U+A4E1/U+A4E3). Visually identical, but breaks naive string matching on title.

city values are codes (NYC/LDN/HKG/SGP), not full names. availability values: 'Full-Time: Experienced', 'Full-Time: New Grad', 'Summer Internship', 'Winter Internship', 'Winter Co-Op', 'Summer Internship (December-February)'.
No posted-at/created-at field exists anywhere in the payload — freshness must come from first_seen_at on our side.
